run_gen_build_yaml: run gen_build_yaml.py to generate YAML build configuration for gRPC naming resolver tests
build_resolver_test_cases: build resolver component test cases from YAML test record groups data
append_zone_name: append a DNS zone name suffix to a given record name string
build_expected_addrs_cmd_arg: build a semicolon-separated command argument string from a list of expected address dictionaries
review_main: review the main function that reads resolver test YAML and outputs build target configuration
